run_dynamic_mask_generation_on_images: run dynamic mask generation on input images using Mask R-CNN to detect and mask dynamic objects
run_dynamic_mask_generation_on_video: run dynamic mask generation on a video file to detect and mask dynamic objects in each frame
run_dynamic_mask_generation_on_webcam: run dynamic mask generation on live webcam input to detect and mask dynamic objects in real time
setup_cfg_detectron2: setup a Detectron2 configuration from a config file and command-line arguments for mask R-CNN inference
get_parser_dynamic_mask: get an argparse parser with arguments for config file, input, output, confidence threshold, and dilation factor
